---
title: "Sector Explorer"
---

Trees were sampled across three lagoon sectors — **upper**, **lower**, and **main creek** — plus a handful of offshore caye sites not yet shown on this map. Click a sector below to see its structure: species mix, trunk diameter (DBH) and height distributions, and the underlying tree-level data. To see biomass by individual field station instead, visit [Sampling Points](sampling-points.qmd).

## Lagoon sectors

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
trees = FileAttachment("data/dataset.json").json()
sectorSummary = FileAttachment("data/sector-summary.json").json()
speciesComposition = FileAttachment("data/species-composition.json").json()
sectorsGeo = FileAttachment("data/placencia-sectors-map.geojson").json()
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
sectorLabels = ({upper: "Upper", lower: "Lower", "main creek": "Main Creek"})
sectorColors = ({upper: "#2c7bb6", lower: "#d7191c", "main creek": "#1a9641"})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
mutable selectedSector = null
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Defined (and displayed, as the live map container) in this same cell:
// a separate cell that only *references* mapDiv would show a generic
// object inspector instead of embedding the live DOM node.
mapDiv = html`<div id="sector-map"></div>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
L = require("leaflet@1.9.4")
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
map = {
  const m = L.map(mapDiv, { scrollWheelZoom: false }).setView([16.62, -88.34], 12);
  L.tileLayer("https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png", {
    attribution: '&copy; <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a>',
    maxZoom: 19,
  }).addTo(m);
  return m;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// Sector polygon layer, built once. Hover state is tracked with a plain
// closure variable (not a reactive `mutable`) so hovering never re-triggers
// the layer rebuild — only clicks notify the rest of the page, via
// `mutable selectedSector`.
sectorGeoLayer = {
  let activeRegion = null;

  function baseStyle(region) {
    return {
      color: "#555",
      fillColor: sectorColors[region] ?? "#ccc",
      weight: 2,
      fillOpacity: 0.45,
    };
  }

  const layer = L.geoJSON(sectorsGeo, {
    style: (f) => baseStyle(f.properties.region),
    onEachFeature: (feature, lyr) => {
      const region = feature.properties.region;
      lyr.bindTooltip(sectorLabels[region] ?? region, { sticky: true, direction: "top" });
      lyr.on({
        mouseover: (e) => e.target.setStyle({ weight: 3, fillOpacity: 0.65 }),
        mouseout: (e) => {
          if (activeRegion !== region) e.target.setStyle(baseStyle(region));
        },
        click: (e) => {
          activeRegion = region;
          mutable selectedSector = region;
        },
      });
    },
  });
  layer.addTo(map);
  return layer;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// Reactive pass: re-applies the "selected" emphasis whenever selectedSector
// changes, without rebuilding the layer.
{
  sectorGeoLayer.eachLayer((lyr) => {
    const region = lyr.feature.properties.region;
    const selected = region === selectedSector;
    lyr.setStyle({
      weight: selected ? 4 : 2,
      fillOpacity: selected ? 0.75 : 0.45,
    });
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
selectedSummary = sectorSummary.find((d) => d.sector === selectedSector)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
selectedSummary
  ? html`<div class="sector-tiles">${[
      ["Trees sampled", selectedSummary.n_trees],
      ["Stations", selectedSummary.n_stations],
      ["Species", selectedSummary.n_species],
      ["Mean DBH", `${selectedSummary.mean_dbh_cm.toFixed(1)} cm`],
      ["Mean height", `${selectedSummary.mean_height_m.toFixed(1)} m`],
      ["Total biomass (sampled trees)", `${selectedSummary.total_biomass_kg.toFixed(0)} kg`],
    ]
      .map(
        ([label, value]) =>
          `<div class="tile"><div class="tile-value">${value}</div><div class="tile-label">${label}</div></div>`
      )
      .join("")}</div>`
  : html`<p class="sector-hint">Click a sector on the map to see its summary, species mix, and tree-level data.</p>`
```

### Species composition

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
sectorSpecies = speciesComposition.filter((d) => d.sector === selectedSector)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
selectedSector == null
  ? html`<p class="sector-hint">No sector selected yet.</p>`
  : Plot.plot({
      marginLeft: 160,
      width: 640,
      x: { label: "Trees sampled" },
      y: { label: null },
      marks: [
        Plot.barX(sectorSpecies, {
          x: "n_trees",
          y: "species",
          fill: sectorColors[selectedSector] ?? "#888",
          sort: { y: "-x" },
        }),
      ],
    })
```

### Structure: DBH & height distributions

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
sectorTrees = trees.filter((d) => d.sector === selectedSector)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
selectedSector == null
  ? html`<p class="sector-hint">No sector selected yet.</p>`
  : html`<div class="chart-row">${[
      Plot.plot({
        width: 340,
        x: { label: "DBH (cm)" },
        y: { label: "Trees" },
        marks: [
          Plot.rectY(
            sectorTrees,
            Plot.binX({ y: "count" }, { x: "dbh_cm", fill: sectorColors[selectedSector] ?? "#888" })
          ),
        ],
      }),
      Plot.plot({
        width: 340,
        x: { label: "Height (m)" },
        y: { label: "Trees" },
        marks: [
          Plot.rectY(
            sectorTrees,
            Plot.binX({ y: "count" }, { x: "height_m", fill: sectorColors[selectedSector] ?? "#888" })
          ),
        ],
      }),
    ]}</div>`
```

### Tree-level data

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
selectedSector == null
  ? html`<p class="sector-hint">No sector selected yet.</p>`
  : Inputs.table(sectorTrees, {
      columns: ["species", "morphotype", "dbh_cm", "height_m", "total_biomass_kg"],
      header: {
        species: "Species",
        morphotype: "Morphotype",
        dbh_cm: "DBH (cm)",
        height_m: "Height (m)",
        total_biomass_kg: "Biomass (kg)",
      },
      sort: "dbh_cm",
      reverse: true,
      rows: 12,
    })
```
